integrity.source_date_note: The cohort anchor is arXiv:2007.00070, first submitted 2020-06-30. The companion polynomial-ring source arXiv:2011.12405 was first submitted 2020-11-24.
integrity.verification: The NIP premises were checked against arXiv/publisher metadata and Hawthorne's full thesis treatment; the instability deduction was rechecked directly.

scientific_limitations: The instability argument is an elementary corollary of the restricted multiplication graph and may be folklore.
The polynomial-ring NIP threshold p>=7 is inherited from Hawthorne and is not improved.
No claim is made about finer NIP ranks or distality.
title: Hawthorne’s sparse-multiplication NIP examples are necessarily unstable
